blocks.text: DAVAO CITY—A coalition of political parties has been formed to secure a majority of the 80-member Bangsamoro Autonomous Region in Muslim Mindanao (BARMM) Parliament, just two weeks before its inaugural session. BARMM interim Chief Minister Abdulraof Macacua told journalists here on Wednesday that the coalition had so far garnered 46 incoming members of parliament (MPs)
